summary: Harden #634/#653: dashboard hydrates durable spend.json, computes budget_pressure + would_pause/throttle next cycle, ranks budget_gate feed items with ask_user_question; feed surfaces cost signal payloads and budget fields on autonomy snap.
migration_impact: Additive dashboard fields (budget_pressure, would_pause_next_cycle, spent_today_durable) and feed item type budget_gate. Hosts should present budget_gate ask_user_question before large unsupervised cycles. No config schema break.
migration_guidance: 2. gh plate costs --dashboard (or plate_costs dashboard=true) to inspect pressure + durable spend.
3. plate_feed / gh plate feed includes budget_gate when pressure elevated/critical; honor presentation ask_user_question.
4. Raise .plate autonomy.token_budget or cost_ceiling_usd when gate fires; keep risk=off to disable enforcement previews that require enabled autonomy.
agent_notes: When feed.autonomy.budget_pressure is critical/exhausted, do not start high-cost unsupervised loops. Prefer small targeted work. Durable counters live under .agentic/budget/spend.json.
